cases.label: good
cases.rationale: Uses one isolation follow-on request, gives each eligible respondent their exact selected material with shared framing, retains no-fit rows, and explains purposeful input variation.

cases.label: bad
cases.rationale: Uses invented batching fields, obscures no-fit coverage, and recommends rerunning matching inputs for more varied results.

cases.label: borderline
cases.rationale: Identifies required source question and selection data, then asks for missing source handles before claiming a runnable request or complete coverage.
